newsitem.title: UK: IPE to close early Nov 28-29, sets Christmas hours.
newsitem.headline: IPE to close early Nov 28-29, sets Christmas hours.

text.p: Trading on the International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) will close early on Nov 28-29 because U.S. markets will be closed those days for the Thanksgiving Day holiday, the IPE said.
In a statement, the IPE, the world's second largest energy futures exchange, said Brent crude oil trading will end by 1730 hours local time (1730 GMT), nearly three hours earlier than normal.
Gas oil futures trade will close at the usual time of 1712 hours local time.
The IPE usually closes early when the New York Mercantile Exchange, the world's largest energy futures exchange, is closed.
